name: prune branches outside the value window
mechanism: while evaluating a two-player game tree with alternating maximiser and minimiser, carry the best values each side is already guaranteed and stop exploring any branch that cannot improve on them

sources.ref: List of algorithms (revid 1373672109), entry 'Alpha–beta pruning' in section Computational mathematics / Optimization algorithms: search to reduce number of nodes in minimax algorithm

fails_when: poor move ordering gives no saving
